name: tool-websearch-brave
description: The `websearch` tool, for the agents that name it: searches the web with the Brave Search API, whose key the model never sees.

environment.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
environment.description: A Brave Search API key, from api-dashboard.search.brave.com (the free plan works). Optional: without it the app starts and each search fails saying so. Read through secrets; the model never sees it.
